$comment: Source of truth for the stack. scripts/sync.py reads this, pulls each upstream at `ref`, copies the selected paths into plugins/<plugin>, applies the patches and regenerates .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and UPSTREAM.lock.

marketplace.name: frontend-stack
marketplace.description: The frontend design stack for Claude Code: Anthropic frontend-design, Impeccable, UI UX Pro Max, Taste and Emil Kowalski's design engineering skills, curated, de-conflicted and kept in sync.

sources.author: Anthropic
sources.description: Anthropic's official frontend-design skill: distinctive, intentional aesthetic direction instead of templated AI defaults.

sources.author: Paul Bakaus
sources.description: Impeccable by Paul Bakaus: 1 skill with 24 commands (/impeccable polish, audit, critique, harden, ...), design agents, anti-pattern detection hooks.

sources.author: Next Level Builder
sources.description: UI UX Pro Max: searchable local database of 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, charts and 22 stack guidelines, plus design-system, brand, banner and slides skills.
sources.$comment: Upstream layout (.claude/skills) is kept on purpose: the skill scripts resolve ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.claude/skills/... and would break if moved.
sources.$comment_patches: Upstream runs `python3 scripts/x.py` relative to the working directory, which is the user's project once installed as a plugin, so the script is not found. ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} is substituted by Claude Code in SKILL.md only, so reference files are left alone.

sources.author: Leonxlnx
sources.description: Taste skills by Leonxlnx: anti-slop landing pages and redesigns, plus opt-in aesthetic presets (minimalist, brutalist, high-end, Stitch).
sources.$comment: Excluded on purpose: taste-skill-v1 (duplicate of design-taste-frontend) and gpt-tasteskill (tuned for GPT models). Image-generation skills live in taste-imagegen.

patches.why: Aesthetic preset. Without narrowing it fires on every UI task and fights the other direction skills.
patches.description: Aesthetic preset, use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a minimalist / editorial / Notion-like look. Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

Aesthetic preset, use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a brutalist / industrial / terminal look. Raw mechanical interfaces fusing Swiss typographic print with military terminal aesthetics. Rigid grids, extreme type scale contrast, utilitarian color, analog degradation effects.

patches.why: Aesthetic preset. Its purple mesh gradients and banned-font list contradict design-taste-frontend's defaults, so it must not auto-trigger.
patches.description: Aesthetic preset, use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a premium agency / Awwwards / 'make it feel expensive' look. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations of a high-end agency site.

patches.why: Writes DESIGN.md in Stitch format, which collides with Impeccable's DESIGN.md. Only for Google Stitch users.
patches.description: Use ONLY when the user is working with Google Stitch and asks for a Stitch DESIGN.md. Generates Stitch-optimized DESIGN.md files with premium, anti-generic UI rules. Do not use to create or edit a project's regular DESIGN.md (Impeccable owns that file).

patches.why: Global behavior override; must be opt-in.
patches.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for complete, untruncated output (no placeholders, no '// rest of code'). Enforces complete code generation and handles token-limit splits cleanly.

sources.author: Leonxlnx
sources.description: Optional. Taste image-first skills (image-to-code, web/mobile design concepts, brand kits). Needs an image-generation tool in your environment.

sources.author: Emil Kowalski
sources.description: Emil Kowalski's design engineering skills: UI polish, animation craft (animate, review, improve, find opportunities), Apple-style motion, prototypes, native-feeling mobile web, library picks.

patches.why: Upstream sets disable-model-invocation, so the Skill tool refuses it and the frontend-stack router and ui-reviewer agent cannot load it. Unlocked with a narrow description instead.
patches.description: Use ONLY when the user asks to review motion, or when the frontend-stack router or ui-reviewer agent delegates a motion review. Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

patches.why: Same as review-animations: the router delegates library picks to it.
patches.description: Use ONLY when the user asks which library to use, or when the frontend-stack router delegates a library pick. Picks the right library for a frontend task from a curated, opinionated list: numbers, OTP inputs, charts, command menus, virtualization, drag and drop, toasts, state, styling, and more.

patches.why: Same as review-animations: the router delegates multi-version prototypes to it.
patches.description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for several versions of a UI piece to compare. Builds multiple genuinely different versions behind a visual picker so the user can flip through them live and promote the one that feels right.

sources.author: Emil Kowalski
sources.description: Optional. Emil Kowalski's native skills: React Native / Expo animation and modern Swift.

local_plugins.description: The glue: a router skill that picks the right skill for each frontend task, resolves the rules that conflict between packs, and ships design-director and ui-reviewer agents.
